annotations.text:
Direction A - Engineering dossier.

Warm paper, editorial serif display, monospace for every number, ruled lines instead of cards. The premise: your portfolio doc's own ethos - verified, nothing rounded up - becomes the visual language.

Four artboards: home, the full work index, one case study, and the home page on a phone.

Two alternate directions are on page 2.

Two other directions, sketched only far enough to judge the look.

Each names its own trade-off at the bottom of the frame. Say which one you want and I'll build the full site into it.
